Three Arrested in Bengaluru Investment Fraud Case

Bengaluru police have arrested three individuals in connection with an alleged investment fraud involving mule bank accounts. Digital forensics identified IP links to Kolkata, Hong Kong, and California, and authorities are investigating potential international connections. The fraud reportedly utilized fake apps and mule accounts, with a cryptocurrency trail also being examined.
